listing.name: PawPrints
listing.abstract: Create blueprint-style craft drawings inside Kitten Space Agency, with projected and exploded views, annotations, and performance blocks.
listing.description:
Turn the craft in your Vehicle Editor into a blueprint you can save, edit and share.

- Start with a blank sheet, use a template, or drag views into a snapping grid. Choose first- or third-angle projection and scale linked views together.
- Create exploded views of a whole craft or a subassembly. Add part labels, flagnotes, dimensions, performance tables and a custom title block.
- Pick a paper theme, add wear, or place a kitten or banana for scale.
- Save an editable drawing to reopen later. Preview your final 4K PNG and its file size before saving it.

Load a craft in the Vehicle Editor and choose **Editor > Open PawPrint Editor** or press **Ctrl+Alt+P**.
